subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on June 15th, 2022. Your itinerary details are as follows: Flight AA123, Departure: 10:00 AM, Arrival: 1:00 PM. Please arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. Should you require any assistance or changes to your booking, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Best regards, The Airline Team
